description: Claude Code only. SCOPE: PLAN ONLY, Phases 1 (preflight) and 2 (scaffold) of /ensemble-development:ensemble:implement-trd-beads run with --plan --foreman; Phases 3-5 (beads-build execution, quality gates, PR creation, completion) are NOT evaluated and need a separate eval. The sandbox holds a 2-PR, 6-task stacked TRD (frontmatter requests stacked PRs), a pinned toolchain (github, plain-git, beads, npm), an initialised br workspace (setup: br init --prefix itb), a bare local origin and a stub gh on PATH that answers only --version, auth status, repo view and pr list and fails closed (logged) on anything else, so any pr create is a recorded failure. The deterministic checks compare the br workspace's exported beads (.beads/issues.jsonl) with what the repo's trd-cli scaffold-plan reports for the fixture TRD (epic, one story per PR, one task bead per TRD task, types, dependency edges), and check that all beads are still open, the first PR branch was created from main and checked out, no other branch exists locally or on origin, main is unmoved, no file outside docs/.beads/.ensemble changed (no product code), gh was only read, and the toolchain preflight record exists. The baseline arm is MEANINGLESS BY CONSTRUCTION: it gets no plugin, no command and no br workflow, so it cannot scaffold and the uplift is the plugin's, not the skill's; read only the with-skill absolute pass rate. NOT SKILL-ATTRIBUTABLE until a trial shows how the with-skill arm gets past step 1.3: the git-town validation script and the git adapters live in packages/git, which this eval does not load; the skill resolves the script under ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/git/..., which does not exist under packages/development, so a HALT there is likely unless the model finds the sibling package; loading packages/git through sharedPackages is a candidate fix that is unproven. Bead labels are not checked: the skill backfills them in Phase 3, outside this scope. Checks show structure, not quality. No measured result is recorded here.
prompt:
docs/TRD/TRD-2026-b1c2d3e4-slugify.md --plan --foreman

This is a non-interactive run against a local sandbox: ask no questions and choose the recommended option. `gh` on PATH is a local stub that answers only a few read calls, so use no other GitHub access and no network. Agent types in this environment are named `ensemble-development:<name>`. Plan only: preflight, create the bead hierarchy and the first feature branch, then stop. Write no product code, run no tests, push nothing, open no pull request and do not start execution.
